import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotientOver
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Pullbacks

/-!
# Morphisms between effective geometric quotients

An equivariant morphism induces a morphism of geometric quotients. If the
target is recovered by base change, every morphism between the quotients
lifts uniquely to an equivariant morphism over the cover. These constructions
give the Hom equivalence used in the scheme part of Milne III.1.13.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] {X Y Z X₀ Y₀ Z₀ S T : Scheme.{u}}
  {actX : G →* Aut X} {actY : G →* Aut Y} {actZ : G →* Aut Z}
  {qX : X ⟶ X₀} {qY : Y ⟶ Y₀} {qZ : Z ⟶ Z₀}
  (hX : IsGeometricQuotient actX qX) (hY : IsGeometricQuotient actY qY)

/-- The morphism on geometric quotients induced by an equivariant morphism. -/
noncomputable def map (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : ∀ g : G, (actX g).hom ≫ f = f ≫ (actY g).hom) : X₀ ⟶ Y₀ :=
  hX.factor (f ≫ qY) (fun g => by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hf g, Category.assoc, hY.invariant g])

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem comp_map (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : ∀ g : G, (actX g).hom ≫ f = f ≫ (actY g).hom) :
    qX ≫ hX.map hY f hf = f ≫ qY :=
  hX.comp_factor _ _

@[simp]
theorem map_id : hX.map hX (𝟙 X) (fun _ => by simp) = 𝟙 X₀ := by
  letI := hX.epi
  apply (cancel_epi qX).mp
  simp

/-- Passing to geometric quotients respects composition. -/
theorem map_comp (hZ : IsGeometricQuotient actZ qZ)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : ∀ g : G, (actX g).hom ≫ f = f ≫ (actY g).hom)
    (f' : Y ⟶ Z) (hf' : ∀ g : G, (actY g).hom ≫ f' = f' ≫ (actZ g).hom) :
    hX.map hZ (f ≫ f') (fun g => by
      rw [← Category.assoc, hf g, Category.assoc, hf' g, Category.assoc]) =
      hX.map hY f hf ≫ hY.map hZ f' hf' := by
  letI := hX.epi
  apply (cancel_epi qX).mp
  simp only [comp_map, comp_map_assoc, Category.assoc]

variable {pX : X ⟶ T} {pY : Y ⟶ T} {rX : X₀ ⟶ S} {rY : Y₀ ⟶ S}
  {b : T ⟶ S} (hcommX : qX ≫ rX = pX ≫ b)
  (hpbY : IsPullback qY pY rY b)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- An equivariant morphism over the cover descends over the base. -/
noncomputable def mapOver (hcommY : qY ≫ rY = pY ≫ b)
    (f : Over.mk pX ⟶ Over.mk pY)
    (hf : ∀ g : G, (actX g).hom ≫ f.left = f.left ≫ (actY g).hom) :
    Over.mk rX ⟶ Over.mk rY :=
  Over.homMk (hX.map hY f.left hf) (by
    change hX.map hY f.left hf ≫ rY = rX
    have hw : f.left ≫ pY = pX := Over.w f
    letI := hX.epi
    apply (cancel_epi qX).mp
    rw [← Category.assoc, comp_map, Category.assoc, hcommY,
      ← Category.assoc, hw, hcommX])

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem comp_mapOver_left (hcommY : qY ≫ rY = pY ≫ b)
    (f : Over.mk pX ⟶ Over.mk pY)
    (hf : ∀ g : G, (actX g).hom ≫ f.left = f.left ≫ (actY g).hom) :
    qX ≫ (hX.mapOver hY hcommX hcommY f hf).left = f.left ≫ qY :=
  hX.comp_map hY f.left hf

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Lift a map of quotients through the target base-change square. -/
noncomputable def liftOver (f : Over.mk rX ⟶ Over.mk rY) :
    Over.mk pX ⟶ Over.mk pY :=
  Over.homMk (hpbY.lift (qX ≫ f.left) pX (by
    have hw : f.left ≫ rY = rX := Over.w f
    rw [Category.assoc, hw, hcommX])) (hpbY.lift_snd _ _ _)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem liftOver_left_comp (f : Over.mk rX ⟶ Over.mk rY) :
    (liftOver hcommX hpbY f).left ≫ qY = qX ≫ f.left :=
  hpbY.lift_fst _ _ _

variable (actT : G →* Aut T)
  (hactX : ∀ g : G, (actX g).hom ≫ pX = pX ≫ (actT g).hom)
  (hactY : ∀ g : G, (actY g).hom ≫ pY = pY ≫ (actT g).hom)

include hX hY hactX hactY in
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The base-change lift commutes with the actions, by the two projections
of the target pullback. -/
theorem liftOver_equivariant (f : Over.mk rX ⟶ Over.mk rY) (g : G) :
    (actX g).hom ≫ (liftOver hcommX hpbY f).left =
      (liftOver hcommX hpbY f).left ≫ (actY g).hom := by
  apply hpbY.hom_ext
  · rw [Category.assoc, liftOver_left_comp, ← Category.assoc,
      hX.invariant g, Category.assoc, hY.invariant g, liftOver_left_comp]
  · have hw : (liftOver hcommX hpbY f).left ≫ pY = pX := Over.w _
    rw [Category.assoc, hw, hactX g, Category.assoc,
      hactY g, ← Category.assoc, hw]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Morphisms of quotients over the base correspond to equivariant morphisms
over the cover when the target quotient square is a pullback. -/
noncomputable def equivariantHomEquiv :
    (Over.mk rX ⟶ Over.mk rY) ≃
      {f : Over.mk pX ⟶ Over.mk pY //
        ∀ g : G, (actX g).hom ≫ f.left = f.left ≫ (actY g).hom} where
  toFun f := ⟨liftOver hcommX hpbY f,
    liftOver_equivariant hX hY hcommX hpbY actT hactX hactY f⟩
  invFun f := hX.mapOver hY hcommX hpbY.w f.1 f.2
  left_inv f := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    letI := hX.epi
    apply (cancel_epi qX).mp
    rw [comp_mapOver_left, liftOver_left_comp]
  right_inv f := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply hpbY.hom_ext
    · rw [liftOver_left_comp, comp_mapOver_left]
    · exact (Over.w _).trans (Over.w _).symm

@[simp]
theorem equivariantHomEquiv_apply_val (f : Over.mk rX ⟶ Over.mk rY) :
    (equivariantHomEquiv hX hY hcommX hpbY actT hactX hactY f).val =
      liftOver hcommX hpbY f := rfl

@[simp]
theorem equivariantHomEquiv_symm_apply
    (f : {f : Over.mk pX ⟶ Over.mk pY //
      ∀ g : G, (actX g).hom ≫ f.left = f.left ≫ (actY g).hom}) :
    (equivariantHomEquiv hX hY hcommX hpbY actT hactX hactY).symm f =
      hX.mapOver hY hcommX hpbY.w f.1 f.2 := rfl

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient
